name: [RELEASE] [ALPHA] Reaper 2
desc:
📖 Complete quests to get stronger and level up, or eat if you are hollow. 

You get a skill point each time you level up, usable in the skill tree to obtain new skills and passives. Equip new skills by opening up your inventory found in the Menu (M).

This game is playable on All Platforms.

🖥️Keyboard:
[E] - Unsheathe 
[M1] - Light
[M2] - Heavy
[F] - Block 
[Q] - Dash 
[P] - Meditate 
[V] - Charge Reiatsu 
[G] - Use Transformation
[H] - Bankai

🎮Controller: 
[LB] + [RB] - Lock-On
[A] - Jump/Parkour
[X] - M1
[Y] - Charge Reiatsu
[B] - Block
[RT] - Dash
[LT] - M2
[RB] - Right Skills
[LB] - Left Skills
Left Joystick Down: Actions Menu
Actions Menu + RT - Unsheathe
D-Pad: Transform and Z, X, C, B skills
